name: COCO 2017
description: Everyday photos of common objects in natural context, Microsoft COCO's 2017 release and the standard object-detection benchmark. Images were gathered from Flickr and annotated by crowdworkers, with many small, occluded, and crowded objects per scene; test-dev labels are withheld, so only train and val are included. Source: Lin et al., "Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context," ECCV 2014; cocodataset.org.
